notices.saved_again: Each recording is saved again by Cassini's {account} account, over the same file: its shares, links and file id stay as they are, and the audio is unchanged.
notices.unreadable: Cassini could not read Nextcloud's capabilities, so it cannot tell whether the Activity and Notifications apps or file versioning are enabled.
notices.unreadable_defaults: Where file versioning is enabled (Nextcloud's default), the file as it was before is kept as an earlier version. Where the Activity app is enabled (also the default), everyone the recording is shared with gets a “file changed” entry for each recording in their Activity stream; Nextcloud may group changes that arrive close together.
notices.email_defaults: With Nextcloud's defaults the change is not emailed and not sent as a notification: both are off for “A file or folder has been changed”. An administrator can change those defaults under Administration settings › Activity, and each person can turn them on in their own Activity settings. Cassini cannot read either. Anyone who turned notifications on gets one per recording; anyone who turned email on finds the changes in their activity email, which Nextcloud collects and sends at the frequency they chose rather than one per change.
notices.versioning_on: File versioning is enabled, so the file as it was before is kept as an earlier version in the {account} account. It takes disk space but does not count against that account's quota. Nextcloud expires versions by versions_retention_obligation in its config.php, which Cassini cannot read, and by the Versions app's limit of half the account's free space, past which the oldest go first.
notices.versioning_off: File versioning is not enabled, so Nextcloud keeps no copy of the file as it was before.
notices.activity_on: The Activity app is enabled, so everyone the recording is shared with gets a “file changed” entry for each recording in their Activity stream; Nextcloud may group changes that arrive close together.
notices.activity_off: The Activity app is not enabled, so the change appears in nobody's activity stream and no activity email is sent.
notices.notifications_off: The Notifications app is not enabled, so no notification can be sent for the change.
notices.notifications_on: The Notifications app is enabled, so a person who turned on notifications for changed files gets one per recording in Nextcloud, and on their devices where push notifications are set up.
notices.web_push_browsers: Web push is allowed, for browsers too, so it can also reach a browser where that person accepted push notifications.
notices.web_push_apps: Web push is allowed, but not for browsers.

secret.title: Connect to Talk’s signaling server
secret.intro: Use the signaling server’s internal client secret. This is different from the recording-backend secret, which Cassini generates itself.
secret.managed: Managed by deployment configuration. Change {variable} in Cassini’s deploy options.
secret.saved: An internal secret is saved. Enter a new value to replace it.
secret.label: Internal secret
secret.why: This is the internal secret your Talk signaling server is configured with. Cassini cannot read it from Talk, which is why it is asked for here.

backend.title: Use Cassini as Talk’s recording backend
backend.intro: Talk needs Cassini's recording-server URL and its recording secret. Cassini generates the secret itself but cannot write Talk's configuration, so the values have to be given to Talk.

test.title: Record a test through Talk
test.intro: Cassini makes itself a conversation for this and waits. The recording is started from Talk, by you, exactly as a real one would be — which is what makes it worth running.
test.step_prepare: Press Prepare test. Cassini creates a conversation named “Cassini recording test” in your name, so that you can moderate it — Talk’s Start recording action belongs to a conversation’s moderators.
test.step_record: Open the room, join the call, and use Talk’s Start recording action.
test.step_speak: Say a few words, then stop the recording in Talk.
test.step_play: Wait for it to publish, then play the audio and confirm you can hear it.
test.note: A recording captures a call, so the call needs someone in it: Cassini joins to record, not to talk. The conversation and the test recording are both ordinary ones, and can be deleted afterwards.

message.check_blocked_unchecked: Not checked: this depends on {blocker}, which has not been checked yet. Run all checks first.

message.connection_not_checked: The Talk connection has not been checked yet.
message.host_checks_unavailable: Cassini could not check disk space and ffmpeg on the recording volume.
message.hpb_authenticated: The signaling server accepted Cassini and advertises media support. A test recording verifies the actual call path.
message.hpb_declared_unverified: Talk names a High Performance Backend. Whether Cassini can authenticate to it is what the Talk connection check below establishes.
message.hpb_declared_unverified_secret_from_env: Talk names a High Performance Backend, and the internal secret comes from Cassini's deployment configuration. Whether that secret is the right one is what this check establishes.
message.hpb_declared_unverified_secret_saved: Talk names a High Performance Backend and an internal secret is saved. Whether Cassini can authenticate with it is what this check establishes.
message.hpb_disabled: Recording cannot work until Talk has a High Performance Backend. Cassini records by joining the call as a hidden participant, and Talk only allows that through standalone signaling — here it is signalling by itself. Nothing else about Talk is affected.
message.hpb_missing: Talk has no standalone signaling server configured. Enable its high-performance backend.
message.hpb_not_checked: Whether Talk has a High Performance Backend has not been established yet, and Cassini can only record through one.
message.hpb_unsupported: The signaling server does not advertise HPB media support.
message.internal_clients_disabled: HPB does not accept internal clients. Ask its administrator to configure {setting}.
message.internal_secret_missing: Talk has a High Performance Backend, and Cassini needs that server's internal secret to join calls invisibly. This is not a Nextcloud setting: it belongs to the signaling server, which is why Cassini cannot read it for you.
message.internal_secret_missing_unverified: Talk has standalone signaling configured. Supply its internal client secret to verify HPB authentication.
message.nextcloud_connection_refused: Nothing answered at the Nextcloud address Cassini was given: the connection was refused.
message.nextcloud_host_not_found: Cassini could not find Nextcloud at the address it was given: the name does not resolve from Cassini's container.
message.nextcloud_server_error: Nextcloud returned a server error while Cassini was reading Talk's settings.
message.nextcloud_timeout: Nextcloud did not answer in time at the address Cassini was given.
message.nextcloud_tls_untrusted: Cassini reached Nextcloud but does not trust its certificate, so it did not read Talk's settings.
message.nextcloud_unexpected_response: Something answered at the Nextcloud address, but not with Talk's settings.
message.nextcloud_unreachable: Could not read Talk settings. Check Nextcloud connectivity and TLS, then try again.
message.probe_failed: The connection check did not finish. Check the recorder installation and connectivity, then retry.
message.recording_auth_rejected: Talk refused Cassini. Cassini is not set up as Talk's recording backend yet, or the recording secret Talk has does not match Cassini's.
message.recording_secret_missing: Cassini has no recording secret. It creates one when it starts and keeps it on its data volume, and that did not succeed.
message.recording_secret_missing_connection: Configure Cassini's recording credential and connect Talk first.
message.setup_store_unreadable: Cassini could not read its saved recording setup, so its Talk credentials cannot be confirmed.
message.sharing_not_checked: Nextcloud's sharing settings have not been checked yet.
message.sharing_permitted: Nextcloud's sharing settings let Cassini share recordings with everyone in a meeting. Whether each person has accepted the share is theirs to decide; anyone with recordings waiting sees them in Browse.
message.sharing_policy_check_timed_out: Nextcloud did not answer in time when Cassini read its sharing settings, so whether they let it share recordings is not known.
message.sharing_policy_unreadable: Cassini could not read Nextcloud's sharing settings, so whether they let it share recordings is not known.
message.signaling_auth_failed: HPB rejected internal-client authentication. Check the internal secret and server authentication configuration.
message.signaling_backend_rejected: The signaling server does not recognise this Nextcloud as one of its backends. Check its backend configuration and the URL Cassini reaches Nextcloud on.
message.signaling_handshake_failed: The signaling handshake did not finish. Check the server connection and try again.
message.signaling_mode_unknown: Cassini could not read Talk's signaling configuration, so it cannot tell whether a High Performance Backend is available.
message.signaling_unreachable: The configured signaling server could not be reached. Check its network route and TLS.
message.storage_admission_blocked: Cassini currently blocks recording on its stored storage status. Review the storage details below and check again after repairing them.
message.storage_incomplete: Cassini cannot store or share recordings in Nextcloud yet. The storage details name the step that failed.
message.storage_not_checked: Nextcloud storage has not been checked yet.
message.storage_not_probed: The Nextcloud storage check does not apply to this publish destination. Verify storage with a test recording.
message.storage_ready: Cassini can store recordings in Nextcloud: its own account exists, its recordings folder is writable, and Nextcloud's sharing API answers. Whether its shares are accepted is the Recording sharing check.
message.talk_backend_url_invalid_app_api_proxy: Cassini's configured Talk backend URL addresses Cassini's own AppAPI proxy, so requests for Talk's settings never reach Talk. Clear {variable} unless a deployment genuinely needs an override; Talk sends the correct backend URL with each recording request.
message.talk_backend_url_invalid_not_a_base_url: Cassini's configured Talk backend URL is not a usable base URL. It must be a plain http(s) URL with no query or fragment. Clear {variable} unless a deployment genuinely needs an override.
message.talk_or_room_unavailable: Talk's recording settings are unavailable: either the Talk app is not enabled, or the conversation Cassini checks with is gone. Check the Talk app, then run this check again — Cassini will make a new conversation if it needs one.
message.test_awaiting_playback: The test recording was published. Playing it is what confirms the audio arrived.
message.test_failed: The test recording did not finish.
message.test_failed_at_stage: The test recording did not finish; it stopped at {stage}.
message.test_waiting_for_talk: Cassini is waiting for a recording started in the test room.
message.test_in_progress: A test recording is in progress.
message.test_in_progress_at_stage: A test recording is in progress: {stage}.
message.test_not_run: Nothing has been recorded through Talk yet. A short test recording is what proves the whole path, from a call to audio you can play.
message.test_playback: A recording started in Talk was published, and its audio was confirmed by playing it.
message.test_room_invalid: Cassini's check conversation could not be resolved. Run this check again and Cassini will make a new one.
message.test_room_unavailable: Cassini could not create the conversation it checks the connection with. Check that Talk is installed and that Cassini's account may create conversations.

sharing.share_api_off: Nobody can receive recordings. Nextcloud's “Allow apps to use the Share API” is off, so every share Cassini makes is refused and no new meetings can be published.
sharing.excluded_groups: Nobody can receive recordings. Nextcloud's “Exclude some groups from sharing” lists {groups}, and Cassini shares from its {account} account, which is in {{count:that group|those groups}}. Every share is refused, so no new meetings can be published.
sharing.no_allowed_group: Nobody can receive recordings. Nextcloud's “Limit sharing to some groups” allows no group at all, so no account may share. Every share is refused, so no new meetings can be published.
sharing.not_in_allowed_groups: Nobody can receive recordings. Nextcloud's “Limit sharing to some groups” allows only {groups}, and Cassini shares from its {account} account, which is in none of them. Every share is refused, so no new meetings can be published.
sharing.in_no_group: Nobody can receive recordings. Nextcloud's “Restrict users to only share with users in their groups” is on, and Cassini shares from its {account} account, which is in no group. Every share is refused, so no new meetings can be published.
sharing.groups_ignored: Nobody can receive recordings. Nextcloud's “Restrict users to only share with users in their groups” is on, and every group the {account} account is in ({groups}) is ignored when Nextcloud checks membership. Every share is refused, so no new meetings can be published.
sharing.only_groups: Only members of {groups} can receive recordings. Nextcloud's “Restrict users to only share with users in their groups” is on, and Cassini shares from its {account} account, which is only in {groups}. Anyone outside these groups cannot open the recordings of their meetings, and a recording they start is not published at all.
sharing.only_admins: Only administrators can receive recordings. Nextcloud's “Restrict users to only share with users in their groups” is on, and Cassini shares from its {account} account, which is only in {groups}, the administrators' group. Anyone who is not an administrator cannot open the recordings of their meetings, and a recording they start is not published at all.
sharing.group_sharing_off: Groups in a room do not receive recordings. Nextcloud's “Allow sharing with groups” is off, so a meeting whose room includes a group is published without access for that group's members, unless they are in the room themselves.

step.allow_sharing_for_everyone: Or allow sharing for everyone under Administration settings › Sharing.
step.check_admin_account: Cassini reads them as the Nextcloud administrator it acts as. Check that Nextcloud is reachable and that account is still an administrator, then check again
step.check_affected_index_entries: Check the affected recordings and their entries in the search index
step.check_affected_transcripts: Check the affected recordings' transcripts. A missing or unreadable transcript has to be fixed before indexing can help
step.check_data_volume_search: Check that Cassini's data volume is mounted and writable: the search index is kept on it
step.check_data_volume_secret: Check that Cassini's data volume is mounted and writable: the secret is saved next to its database
step.check_firewall: Check that no firewall between Cassini's container and Nextcloud drops the connection
step.check_media_host: Check the recorder's media tools and its recording volume, then run the checks again
step.check_nextcloud_listening: Check that Nextcloud is running and listening on that address and port
step.check_nextcloud_running: Check that Nextcloud is running, and is not overloaded or part-way through a restart
step.check_proxy: A proxy may be answering in Nextcloud's place. Make sure {nextcloud_url}, or {backend_url} when set, points at Nextcloud itself
step.check_recordings_catalog: Check the recordings catalog and try the archive check again
step.check_search_index: Check the search index database and try again
step.check_search_index_available: Check that Cassini's search index database is available, then check again
step.check_transcription_settings: Check transcription settings and that the model is ready. Indexing again cannot add words to recordings that were never transcribed
step.choose_allowed_groups: Choose the groups allowed to share under Administration settings › Sharing, including one {account} is in.
step.create_directory: create {path} or choose a path you can write to
step.deploy_through_appapi: Cassini is running without its AppAPI settings ({variables}). Deploy it through AppAPI rather than starting its container by hand
step.enable_group_sharing: Turn on “Allow sharing with groups” under Administration settings › Sharing.
step.enable_share_api: Turn on “Allow apps to use the Share API” under Administration settings › Sharing.
step.enable_talk: Confirm the Talk app is enabled, then run this check again
step.find_standalone_internal_secret: On a standalone signaling server, it is {key} under {section} in its configuration file
step.fix_storage_first: Recording storage uses the same access to the archive. If it needs attention, fix that first
step.fix_tmpdir: free space or permissions in the system temp directory, or run with {variable} set to a writable location
step.fix_workdir_permissions: change into a writable working directory or fix directory permissions before running Cassini
step.join_allowed_group: Add {account} to one of {groups} on Nextcloud's Users page.
step.join_common_group: Or add {account} to a group everyone who records is in. It does not need to be an administrator. Keep it there: removing it later makes Nextcloud remove people's access to recordings already shared through that group.
step.join_every_group: Or add {account} to every group whose members should receive recordings. A group everyone is in covers everybody; {account} does not need to be an administrator. Keep it there: removing it later makes Nextcloud remove people's access to recordings already shared through that group.
step.leave_excluded_groups: Or take {account} out of {groups} on Nextcloud's Users page.
step.lift_group_restriction: Turn off “Restrict users to only share with users in their groups” under Administration settings › Sharing.
step.match_certificate_name: The address Cassini uses must also match the name the certificate was issued for
step.nextcloud_address: Cassini reaches Nextcloud at {nextcloud_url}, or at {backend_url} when that is set. The address has to work from inside Cassini's container, not only from your browser
step.paste_secret_unchanged: Paste it unchanged — one differing character fails exactly as a wrong credential would, and nothing can tell the difference until this check runs
step.print_aio_internal_secret: On Nextcloud All-in-One, print it with:
step.read_nextcloud_log: Nextcloud's log says what failed: Administration settings → Logging, or {file} on the server
step.read_search_backfill_log: The full error is in Cassini's log. On the Docker host:
step.recheck_slow_nextcloud: Check again. If it keeps running out of time, Nextcloud is answering slowly: the Recording storage check above uses the same connection
step.recheck_storage_to_list_archive: Check Recording storage again so Cassini can list the archive, then check search again
step.reenable_app: Disable and re-enable Cassini in Nextcloud, which re-runs its setup
step.reindex_adds: Re-index now adds the {count:number|num} {{recording that is|recordings that are}} not in search yet
step.restart_app: Then restart Cassini by disabling and re-enabling it in Nextcloud's apps
step.restart_app_new_secret: Then restart Cassini by disabling and re-enabling it in Nextcloud's apps, which creates the secret again
step.restore_setup_store: Check that Cassini's persistent volume is mounted and writable, then restore {file} from a backup if it is missing
step.retry_reindex: If it passes, Nextcloud was probably busy or restarting, so try re-indexing again
step.set_recording_secret: Or set one yourself in {variable}, in Cassini's deploy options. A secret set there always wins
step.stop_ignoring_groups: Or stop ignoring {groups} under “Ignore the following groups when checking group membership”.
step.test_nextcloud_address: To test the address, run this on the Nextcloud host. It should print an HTTP status such as 200, not an error:
step.unexclude_groups: Remove {groups} from the excluded groups under Administration settings › Sharing.
step.use_trusted_certificate: A self-signed or private certificate is not trusted from inside Cassini's container. Use a publicly trusted certificate on Nextcloud, or point {backend_url} at an address whose certificate Cassini trusts
step.wait_for_nextcloud: Nextcloud may be in maintenance mode or still starting. Wait for it, then check again
